title: Residual Share Percent for Member Appeals to Out-of-Network Plans Paying Second — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — member appeals to an out-of-network plan that pays second.** The member's residual is the capped charges times the second-plan member appeal's residual share percent, divided by one hundred. The residual share percent follows the deductible the member has met on the coverage:

- **40 percent** (out-of-network coinsurance percent) where the deductible amounts assigned on the coverage within the last twelve months reach the out-of-network deductible satisfied amount of 500.00 USD;
- **70 percent** (out-of-network deductible phase percent) where some deductible was assigned within those twelve months but the amounts stay below 500.00 USD;
- **55 percent** (out-of-network standard residual percent) otherwise.

Deductible amounts are the patient-responsibility lines of the deductible type assigned on the coverage within the twelve months.

## Truth table

| Deductible assigned in twelve months | At least 500.00? | Residual share percent |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 40 |
| Yes | No | 70 |
| No | — | 55 |

## Basis Q&A

**Does a total of exactly 500.00 USD count as reaching the amount?** Yes; it takes 40 percent. A total of 499.99 USD takes 70 percent.

**Hypothetical residual.** Capped charges of 380.00 USD with 120.00 USD of deductible assigned in the twelve months: 70 percent, so the member's residual is 380.00 times 70, divided by one hundred, 266.00 USD.
